faq-open-banking-body-1: Bank connections go through <providerLink>Enable Banking</providerLink>, using your own Enable Banking application and key, which you create and control. You authorize access with your bank through Enable Banking, and WonderMoney never sees your bank login details.
faq-open-banking-body-2: Access is read-only: WonderMoney can read your account details, balances and transactions, and cannot make payments or move money. Your consent lasts for the period your bank allows, and Settings > Connections shows when it expires; after that, reconnect the bank to keep it syncing. You can withdraw your consent with your bank at any time, or remove the connection in Settings > Connections to stop syncing it.

faq.title: What changed at WonderMoney
faq.intro: A quick explanation of how WonderMoney works now.
faq.q1Body: We're a bootstrapped, two-person team. User acquisition in personal finance is expensive, and it didn't grow as fast as we hoped. On top of that, open banking connections cost real money per user, and we could no longer cover that cost while keeping the quality bar we set for ourselves.
faq.q2Body: No. We still believe in WonderMoney — it's one of the few genuinely all-in-one personal finance apps built in the EU. We changed how it's funded, not whether it exists.
faq.q3Body: WonderMoney is now free and open source. To connect a bank, you add your own free Enable Banking key in Settings, instead of WonderMoney paying for the connection behind the scenes. Our docs walk you through setting it up. Anyone can also run WonderMoney on their own server.
faq.q4Body: Your data is safe and untouched. WonderMoney is free for everyone — there are no trials or subscriptions, so every account has full access.
faq.q5Title: Can you recommend another app instead?
faq.q5Body: Honestly, we can't. We built WonderMoney because we couldn't find another all-in-one app that did what it does, and we still haven't.
faq.supportTitle: Can I help keep WonderMoney running?
faq.supportBody: Yes, if you'd like to. The app is free, but the servers, AI features and market data behind it aren't. You can <link>chip in here</link>. It's entirely optional and changes nothing in the app.
faq.q6Body: Reach out any time at {email}. We read everything.

import-statement-ambiguous-dates: These dates could be day first or month first. If they look wrong, change the date format below.
import-statement-invert: Spending is shown as a positive amount
import-statement-unreadable: We couldn't open this file. Choose a CSV or Excel export of your statement.
import-review-stalled: The import stopped before it finished. Try again to carry on from where it stopped; nothing is imported twice.
import-review-read-failed: We couldn't read this file. Choose a CSV or Excel export of your statement.
import-review-expired: This import expired before it was finished. Start again with the file.
import-review-summary: Nothing is imported until you confirm. New transactions are included; ones already in the account are skipped.
import-review-commit: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing to import} one {Import # transaction} other {Import # transactions}}
import-review-mapping-title: This file holds several accounts. Choose where each one goes.
import-review-date-order-title: These dates could be day first or month first.

import-review-date-order-hint-month-firs: The file doesn't say, so they were read month first (01/15/2026 is 15 January). Choose the other order if that's wrong.

import-review-done-failed: {failed, plural, one {# row couldn't be imported} other {# rows couldn't be imported}}.

portfolioAccountLink.question: Does this account's balance include your investments?
portfolioAccountLink.includes-holdings-hint: Net worth counts the account and shows this portfolio without adding it again.
portfolioAccountLink.cash-only-hint: Net worth counts the account's cash and this portfolio.
portfolioAccountLink.managed-by-partner: This portfolio is linked to an account only the other household member can see, so only they can change the link.
portfolioAccountLink.suggestion-body: You have an investment account and a portfolio that isn't linked to an account. If the account already holds the portfolio, link them so net worth counts it once.
portfolioAccountLink.suggestion-body-create: If this portfolio is held in one of your accounts, link it so net worth doesn't count the same money twice.
portfolioAccountLink.dialog-title: Link a portfolio to its account

counts-as-spending-description: When this is off, rows in this category are left out of spending in reports, budgets and the home cash flow.
counts-as-spending-parent-off: Its parent category doesn't count as spending, so neither does this one.

transferEdit.mark-as-transfer-description: Money moved between your own accounts, savings or investments. Transfers are left out of spending, income and budgets.

budget-rollover-toggle: Roll over leftover to next month
budget-rollover-toggle-help: What's left this month is added to next month's amount for this category.
budget-rollover-carries-overspend-help: When off, only unspent money rolls over

accountRecalculate.title: Recalculate balances for {name}?
accountRecalculate.description: This rebuilds the running balance of every transaction on the account. A manual or imported account starts from its opening balance; a bank-connected account ends on the balance your bank reports. Amounts stored without an exchange rate are converted again where a rate now exists.
accountRecalculate.safe-hint: Your transactions are not changed, and on an account whose balances are already right nothing changes.
accountRecalculate.background-hint: You can close this window; the recalculation carries on in the background.
accountRecalculate.continues: Balances are still being recalculated in the background.
accountRecalculate.already-correct: Balances checked: they were already correct.
accountRecalculate.done: {count, plural, one {Balances recalculated: # transaction corrected} other {Balances recalculated: # transactions corrected}}
accountRecalculate.failed: The balances could not be recalculated. Try again in a few minutes.
accountRecalculate.too-soon: This account was recalculated less than a minute ago. Try again shortly.
accountRecalculate.error: The recalculation could not be started. Try again.

fx.not-converted-hint: No exchange rate for {currency} yet, so this amount stays in {currency} and is left out of totals.
fx.estimated-hint: Converted at the rate from {date}, the latest one available. It is converted again when a newer rate arrives.
fx.estimated-hint-no-date: Converted at an older rate, the latest one available. It is converted again when a newer rate arrives.
fx.incomplete-label: Not every amount could be converted
fx.total-leaves-out: This total leaves out {count, plural, one {# account, loan or portfolio} other {# accounts, loans or portfolios}} that could not be valued in {currency}.

errors.account-phase-failed: Your bank didn't send the account list.

errors.cancelled: The bank connection was cancelled before it finished.
errors.consent-expired: Your access to this bank has expired.

errors.internal: Something went wrong on our side.
errors.invalid-requisition: This bank connection is no longer valid.
errors.rate-limited: The bank limited how often we can sync.
errors.timeout: Your bank took too long to respond.
errors.transaction-phase-failed: Your bank didn't send the transactions.

version.copy-failed: Could not copy the version info. Try again.

mobile-pairing-totp-hint: Only needed if two-factor authentication is on for your account.
mobile-pairing-qr-label: QR code that pairs the WonderMoney mobile app with this server
mobile-pairing-expired: This code has expired. Show a new one.
mobile-pairing-scan-hint: In the app, tap “Scan QR code” on the sign-in screen.
mobile-pairing-error-totp-required: Enter your authenticator code to continue.
mobile-pairing-error-invalid-totp: That authenticator code is not valid.
mobile-pairing-error-session-not-fresh: Sign in again before connecting a device.
mobile-pairing-error-create: Could not create a pairing code. Try again.
mobile-devices-description: Phones signed in to your account with a QR code.
mobile-devices-error-revoke: Could not revoke that device. Try again.
mobile-devices-revoke-description: {name} will be signed out and must scan a new QR code to connect again.
